''[[PS609|Kyogre Returns]]'' (Second Courtney) }} |} '''Courtney''' (Japanese: '''カガリ''' ''Kagari'') is one of the {{tc|Magma Admin|Admin}}s of [[Team Magma]]. ==In the core series games== Courtney plays a key role in the main story in {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s|Pokémon Ruby}} and its remake {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Pokémon Omega Ruby}} as an Admin to the main villainous team, [[Team Magma]]. Her appearances in the corresponding games Pokémon Sapphire and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire are limited to minor appearances, as [[Team Aqua]] are the main villains of these games. In Pokémon Ruby, Courtney is first encountered at the [[Weather Institute]] attempting to steal {{p|Castform|the weather Pokémon}}. She later boards the [[Submarine Explorer 1|submarine]] descending towards the [[Seafloor Cavern]] in order to awaken {{p|Groudon}}. She is battled by the {{player}} before Magma Leader [[Maxie]]. In Pokémon Sapphire, {{tc|Aqua Admin}} [[Shelly]] fulfills the same role. Due to the nature of {{game|Emerald}} combining the stories of Pokémon Ruby and Pokémon Sapphire, Courtney isn't battled at all, as her role in Ruby is taken by Shelly. She only makes a brief non-talking cameo appearance alongside Maxie and [[Tabitha]] at the Seafloor Cavern after [[Archie]] awakens {{p|Kyogre}}. In Pokémon Omega Ruby, Courtney sends a recon team, including [[Zinnia]], to investigate and steal the [[Devon Parts]] for Team Magma; upon failing, the recon team warns her about the player. She eventually discovers the location of the [[Red Orb]] and informs Maxie, causing him to cancel the operation at [[Mt. Chimney]]. Courtney is next seen at [[Southern Island]], trying to steal {{p|Latios}} and the [[Latiosite]] for Team Magma, but is stopped by the player and [[Steven Stone]], summoned by {{p|Latias}} to help. She later accompanies Maxie to Mt. Pyre, where they retrieve the Red Orb. When the player arrives and tries to stop them, Maxie has Courtney battle them while he departs to steal the [[Submarine Explorer 1]] at [[Slateport City]]. When the player invades the [[Team Magma Hideout]], Courtney once again battles them in order to buy time for Maxie to leave for Seafloor Cavern unobstructed. She later watches on as the {{a|Desolate Land|harsh sunlight}} dispels upon Groudon's defeat or capture. In the [[Delta Episode]], Courtney plots to fulfill Maxie's crushed dream and takes matters into her own hands. She is encountered in [[Petalburg City]] harassing [[Wally]], in the search for her own [[Key Stone]]. Wally insists that he does not have his Key Stone any more, as it was recently stolen by [[Zinnia]]. She then battles the {{player}} in an attempt to steal their Key Stone, and after the battle leaves for [[Meteor Falls]]. It is there whereupon she obtains her own Key Stone and with it launches an attack of the [[Mossdeep Space Center]]. She and a {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}} battle in a [[Multi Battle]] with [[Steven Stone]] and the player, during which she shows her ability to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] her {{p|Camerupt}}. After being stopped, Zinnia appears and Zinnia's {{p|Whismur}} steals Courtney's Key Stone. In these games, Courtney is characterized by her bizarre speech patterns, which often involve pauses between words and speaking in a way that sounds robotic. She displays little to no emotion, but she looks up to [[Maxie]]. Courtney has high intelligence and was once a scientist. When she becomes interested in someone or something, she will pursue it {{color2|fff|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Courtney/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===Pokémon Generations=== [[File:Magma Admin Courtney PG.png|thumb|250px|Courtney in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] Courtney appeared in ''[[PG07|The Vision]]''. She was initially seen guarding the [[Submarine Explorer 1]] at the [[Team Magma Hideout]], and later stayed behind as [[Maxie]] and [[Tabitha]] left for the [[Seafloor Cavern]]. While she was alone, she experienced a vision of [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{p|Groudon}} attacking [[Team Magma]] with {{m|Solar Beam}}. However, before she could mull over the vision's meaning, she was interrupted by the arrival of {{ga|Brendan}} and his {{p|Sceptile}}, and she sent out her {{p|Camerupt}} to battle them, her resolve towards Team Magma's plans restored. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |width=68 |trainer=Courtney |pkmn=Camerupt |img=Courtney Camerupt PG.png |type1=Fire |type2=Ground |epnum=PG07 |epname=The Vision |desc={{p|Camerupt}} is Courtney's only known Pokémon. It was seen being sent out to battle {{ga|Brendan}}'s {{p|Sceptile}}. None of Camerupt's moves are known.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{omega ruby color light}}|bordercolor={{omega ruby color}} |ja=福圓美里 ''[[Misato Fukuen]]'' |en=Sandy Fox |nl=Fleur van de Water |pt_br=Christiane Monteiro |es_eu=Roser Vilches}} ==In the manga== [[File:Courtney Adventures.png|thumb|200px|The first Courtney in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== In Pokémon Adventures, there are two Admins with the name "Courtney". {{spoilers}} ====First Courtney==== When she was younger, Courtney was a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] with a friend [[Daisy Oak]] and a more optimistic outlook on things. During this period she managed to earn some Ribbons, as a merit for the way she took care of her Pokémon. Sometime later she joined Team Magma and became one of the organization's Admins. In the [[Chuang Yi]] translations, she is known as '''Marge'''. ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== The first Courtney debuted in the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. She is one of the [[Magma Admin (Trainer class)#In the manga|Three Fires]] of Team Magma, alongside Tabitha and [[Blaise]]. Like other members of Team Magma, the horns on Courtney's hood can be removed to reveal a special lighter that can transmit and record images through its flame. Courtney also wears gloves that gain specific abilities through combining the juices of Berries. With a [[Tamato Berry]], it can temporarily blind the target if the burning juices comes in contact with their eyes; with a {{b|Pomeg}} and [[Kelpsy Berry]], it creates a sticky adhesive that prevents the held target from escaping; with a {{b|Qualot}} and [[Hondew Berry]] mixed with the acid of a {{p|Weepinbell}}, it becomes a corrosive that can melt through walls and flesh easily. Like the other Three Fires, Courtney specializes in using flames to her advantage. In her case, she uses fire to burn her opponents to ash. She first appears alongside Tabitha on the [[Abandoned Ship]], where they were sent to obtain the [[Scanner]] hidden aboard. There, they meet {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}}, both of which attempt to keep the Scanner out of Courtney and Tabitha's hands. In the end, Ruby and Sapphire escape, but Courtney and Tabitha manage to obtain the Scanner. The Scanner is later given to Blaise, who modifies it to search for the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s. At Slateport City, Courtney, Tabitha, and Blaise are sent to capture [[Captain Stern]] and his assistant, [[Dock]] in order to obtain the Submarine Explorer 1. In the end, Blaise manages to obtain the submarine for Team Magma's use. At Rusturf Tunnel, Courtney leads several Team Magma Grunts in helping raise the energy level of the land by creating earthquake's to stimulate the earth's crust as well as looking for the Red Orb. When she notices Ruby is there, Courtney leaves the Grunts behind to forcibly take Ruby further inside the tunnel. With no one around, Courtney forces Ruby to battle her since no one can see him fight. During the fight, Courtney attempts to convince Ruby to join Team Magma since she shares his love of beauty. Ruby refuses the offer and manages to trap Courtney in a sea of fire as he escapes to safety. Courtney survives the flames, but decides to hand over the search for the Red Orb over to Blaise. She then decides to take a leave of absence from Team Magma due to gaining an interest in Ruby. [[File:Ruby Courtney Adventures.png|thumb|left|220px|Courtney and Ruby]] When {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}} are awakened, Courtney is called by her teammates to return to action. When the Gym Leaders split into groups in an attempt to stop both Pokémon, the Admins of Teams Magma and Aqua split up to stop them. Courtney is paired up against Roxanne, who has stopped Groudon from moving with her {{p|Nosepass}}'s {{m|Block}}. After dragging Roxanne to an abandoned Lilycove City to battle, the two face each other in Cove Lily Motel. Roxanne's strong defenses prevent Courtney from defeating her, but she is forced to surrender when Courtney takes three people hostage. With Roxanne defeated, Groudon is freed from Block, allowing it to advance once again. [[File:End Courtney Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Courtney in {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} epilogue]] During the battle between Groudon and Kyogre, Courtney appears to Ruby as he trains with Sapphire on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}. She reveals to Ruby that she only joined Team Magma for her own amusement and that the events of Groudon and Kyogre's awakening has spiraled out of Team Magma and Aqua's expectations. Courtney offers to help stop the two super-ancient Pokémon by using one of the two Orbs used to control Groudon and Kyogre. Once Ruby and Sapphire had set off of Mirage Island to fight Groudon and Kyogre, Sapphire is locked inside an aircar by Ruby, who gives Courtney the Blue Orb. The two use the Orbs to try and control Groudon and Kyogre, but due to the lack of training needed to control the Orbs, Courtney is unable to use it to its full potential. During the battle, Courtney is grabbed by a tentacle and knocked to the ground. Just before she is dragged away, Courtney gives Ruby a message that his father, [[Norman]], will be coming with {{p|Rayquaza}} to help stop the fight. The tentacle drags Courtney into the collapsing [[Cave of Origin]], which crushes her to death. Once Archie and Maxie were defeated, Ruby used his {{p|Celebi}} to revive all the people that were killed in the final battle. Courtney is brought back to life thanks to Celebi's [[time travel]] abilities. Afterward, Courtney leaves to pursue a normal life and begins cultivating Berries. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== Courtney is seen in a flashback of Ruby's after he and {{adv|Emerald}} were informed by Steven about the upcoming disaster about to strike Hoenn. There, Ruby decides that the two of them should look at Courtney's memories in her Memory Lighter that she had given to him. While looking through them they both discover that Zinnia had infiltrated Team Magma and was the one who had given them information regarding Groudon. =====Pokémon===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Courtney |pkmn=Swellow |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Courtney Swellow Adventures.png |epnum=PS199 |epname=Adding It Up with Plusle & Minun II |desc={{p|Swellow}} is Courtney's first known Pokémon. It is mainly used for flight transportation. Swellow's only known move is {{m|Fly}}{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}, and its Ability is {{a|Guts}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Courtney |pkmn=Ninetales |stage1=Vulpix |type1=Fire |gender=female |img=Daisy Clefairy Courtney Vulpix Follow Me Tail Whip Adventures.png |cap=Courtney's Vulpix |img2=Courtney Ninetales Adventures.png |epnum=PS199 |epname=Adding It Up with Plusle & Minun II |desc={{p|Ninetales}} is Courtney's second known Pokémon and her main battling force. She was first used to battle Ruby and Sapphire on the Abandoned Ship. At Rusturf Tunnel, she battled against Ruby once again. At the Cove Lily Motel, she faced Roxanne's {{p|Cradily}}. She was unable to penetrate Cradily's defenses, but when Courtney took hostages, Roxanne was forced to surrender and allow Ninetales to defeat her Nosepass and free Groudon from {{m|Block}}. In a flashback shown in ''[[PS262|It All Ends Now III]]'', it was revealed that she owned Ninetales since she was a {{p|Vulpix}} and used her in [[Pokémon Contest]]s alongside [[Daisy Oak]]. Ninetales's known moves are {{m|Fire Spin}}, {{m|Hyper Beam}}, {{m|Tail Whip}}, {{m|Flamethrower}}, {{m|Ember}}{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}, and {{m|Sunny Day}}{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}} and her Ability is {{a|Flash Fire}}.}} =====Contests===== ======Hoenn Ribbons====== This listing is of the [[Ribbon]]s Courtney has obtained in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]: * Unknown Rank [[Beautiful (condition)|Beauty]] Contest (prior to {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}) ====Second Courtney==== [[File:ORAS Magma Aqua Admins Adventures.png|thumb|250px|The second Courtney in Pokémon Adventures]] In the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}, a second Courtney appeared as a member of Neo Team Magma (Japanese: '''新生マグマ団''' ''Neo Magma Gang''). She, along with a second Tabitha, took the name of her predecessor as a codename. In ''[[PS609|Kyogre Returns]]'', Courtney appeared at [[Mossdeep City]] to help Zinnia interfere with the [[Devon Corporation]]'s plan to launch a rocket that would stop the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteoroid]] threatening to destroy the world. Along with Matt, Courtney attacked Sapphire, distracting her long enough for Zinnia to land on the rocket. Sapphire dodged their attacks, allowing her to escape and pursue Zinnia. In [[PS612]], the Admins were attacked by the Hoenn [[Frontier Brain]]s and defeated. The Brains attempted to interrogate the Admins on Zinnia's whereabouts, only for them to admit they had no idea where she ran off to. =====Pokémon===== {{TrainerPoké |width=74 |trainer=Courtney |pkmn=Numel |type1=Fire |type2=Ground |img=ORAS Courtney Numel Adventures.png |img_size=150px |epnum=PS609 |epname=Kyogre Returns |desc={{p|Numel}} is Courtney's only known Pokémon.
